title: Personal views, first version (ui half): 「我的视图」 in the view switcher, save as my view for any reader, rename, delete, and set as my default, on the landed sys_personal_view
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjPiXgNoSaEpqeGvY

立卡门类别: ③ 维护者直派 — step 2 of the #28971 ruling C execution (ruling 6570568131; the maintainer's 「同意」), split out of #29443 now that step 1 has landed. Refs #28971, #29443.
reach: every reader of every list view in the Console.
业务理由: as in #29443. A reader keeps several named working sets on one list. Today one unnamed setting per view is overwritten by the next filter, and creating a view is admin-only and visible to everyone.
动手的读者: a `domain:ui` seat. The ui lane has no seat at the moment, so this waits in the queue until one opens.
查重 (includes closed issues): `我的视图 switcher` and `personal view ui` find only #28971 (the ruling), #29443 (step 1) and #27943 (the switcher precedent). **New.**

## What step 1 landed (PR #29575, `4008e6290f`)

- **Object:** `sys_personal_view` (platform-objects identity). It is owner-only and organization-scoped. Its configuration is spec's `ListView` shape, validated on save. A `config.data.object` that differs from `object_name` is refused 400, and a non-system `user_id` change is refused 403.
- **Create, list, read, rename:** through the data API as the owner, `/api/v1/data/sys_personal_view`.
- **Delete:** `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id`, the own-row door. Another member or an org admin gets 404, and a readable foreign row gets 403. The generic data DELETE answers 403 for a member.
- **Boundaries stated in the PR:** `admin_full_access` can read, edit and delete a member's view (the rescue path, the same as `sys_user_preference`). External members (`external_default`) have **no grant** in this version.
- **No default store on the server.** "Set as my default" reuses the Console's existing per-object pin `LIST_PINNED_VIEW_PREFERENCE` (#27594). That pin holds any non-empty view id, and `resolveViewId` matches it exactly, so a personal view's id works once the switcher lists personal views.

## Wanted

- The switcher shows a 「我的视图」 group: the merged set of package views, environment views, and the reader's own rows.
- **Save as my view** is available to any reader who can read the list (not admin-only). It saves the current filter, sort, columns and so on as a `ListView` body.
- **Rename and delete** use the data API and the own-row door above.
- **Set as my default** writes the existing pin with the personal view's id.
- Precedents: #27943 (switcher), objectui#12471 (user-owned list state).
- Open questions carried from step 1: whether external members should get the feature (a separate posture decision; the server grants nothing today), and the presentation when a pinned personal view has been deleted (fall back to the default view).

Not in: sharing, team views, admin management, a field picker, packaging, import and export (#29443 "Not in").
